function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file, returning numbered lines. Use offset/limit to page through; files over ~5 MB or non-regular files are refused.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file. Parent directories are created.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace old_string with new_string in a file. old_string must occur exactly once — include surrounding context.

function.name: insert_before
function.description: Insert text as whole new line(s) immediately BEFORE the line containing anchor. anchor must occur exactly once — include surrounding context. The anchor's own line is never modified; use this instead of edit_file when you mean to add a line, not replace one.

function.name: insert_after
function.description: Insert text as whole new line(s) immediately AFTER the line containing anchor. anchor must occur exactly once — include surrounding context. The anchor's own line is never modified; use this instead of edit_file when you mean to add a line, not replace one.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List a directory's entries (dirs end with /).

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regex. Optional glob filter like '*.cs' or '*.tsx'.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command in the worktree (cwd is the worktree root). Use for builds/tests/git-status, NEVER for editing files. 120s default timeout, 600s max. Backgrounded processes are terminated when the command returns. In docker mode, a stray background process or an out-of-memory container triggers an automatic reset: the working tree survives, but any git state you created inside the sandbox (index changes, stashes, local commits) does not — write_file/edit_file changes and anything already written to disk are unaffected.

function.name: finish
function.description: End the run. Call this once the task is complete and verified (tests/build run, changes committed if the task asked for commits). summary: 2-6 sentences on what you did and anything left undone.
